name: Tienda Inglesa
description: Supermarket chain in Uruguay with an online store and Click&Go pickup. Sells groceries, beverages, household and personal care, and appliances. States home delivery across Uruguay, with interior orders sent through DAC; free interior shipping above a stated threshold and a fixed fee below it. Rural addresses are excluded and some perishable categories are not delivered to the interior.
description_es: Cadena de supermercados de Uruguay con tienda online y retiro Click&Go. Vende comestibles, bebidas, limpieza y cuidado personal, y electrodomésticos. Indica entrega a domicilio en todo Uruguay, con pedidos al interior enviados por DAC; envío gratis al interior por encima de un monto indicado y tarifa fija por debajo. No se entrega en zonas rurales y algunas categorías perecederas no se envían al interior.

ships_to.notes: Interior delivery via DAC nationwide; free above a stated threshold and fixed fee below it. Rural addresses excluded. Perishables not shipped to the interior.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at DAC agencies nationwide and Click&Go pickup points.
